# Akaki Kality Administration Portal • አቃቂ ቃሊቲ

> Official civic portal for Akaki Kality Sub-City Prosperity Party (PR) and civic administration in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

The portal provides residents, visitors, and researchers with transparent information regarding sub-city leadership, urban development initiatives, community programs, civic values, and public infrastructure.

## Core Navigation
- [Home Portal](https://kality-sucbity-medai.vercel.app/): Overview of Akaki Kality sub-city, key statistics, and geographic orientation.
- [Administration & Leadership](https://kality-sucbity-medai.vercel.app/#leadership): Leadership directory, executive responsibilities, and institutional priorities.
- [Vision & Strategic Pillars](https://kality-sucbity-medai.vercel.app/#vision): Strategic roadmap, institutional milestones, and inclusive economic development goals.
- [Public Facilities & Gallery](https://kality-sucbity-medai.vercel.app/#gallery): Visual records of public infrastructure, urban revitalization, and community programs.

## Administrative Services
- [Admin Access](https://kality-sucbity-medai.vercel.app/admin/login): Administrative sign-in portal for authorized communications personnel.
